topic: Role of Fiber in Diabetic Diet
questionText: Why is a high-fiber diet (soluble fiber from oats, legumes, vegetables) recommended for diabetic individuals?

options.text: It slows gastric emptying and delays carbohydrate absorption, preventing sharp post-prandial blood glucose spikes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Role of Fiber in Diabetic Diet.

options.text: It causes blood sugar to rise five times faster than pure sugar
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: It prevents all nutrients from being digested in the stomach
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Yoga and Yogic Practices (Role of Fiber in Diabetic Diet):
It slows gastric emptying and delays carbohydrate absorption, preventing sharp post-prandial blood glucose spikes

Detailed Context:
Soluble dietary fiber forms a viscous gel in the intestine, slowing carbohydrate hydrolysis and glucose absorption.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
